ShapeEngine
Table of Contents

Namespace ShapeEngine.Timing

Classes

Actionable

Represents an actionable sequenceable object that performs a specified action over a given duration.

BasicTimer

A basic timer class for tracking elapsed and remaining time, supporting pause, resume, stop, cancel, and restart operations.

Repeater

Represents a sequenceable timer that repeats an action for a specified number of times, with a customizable duration for each repeat cycle.

SequencerState<T>

Represents the state of a sequencer for a specific type implementing ISequenceable. Holds a copy of the provided sequences.

SequencerTimedFloat<T>

A sequencer for types implementing ISequenceableTimedFloat. Accumulates and applies timed float values in sequence, updating the total accordingly.

Sequencer<T>

Manages and updates sequences of items implementing ISequenceable. Supports starting, updating, cancelling, and restoring sequences.

TimedFloat

Represents a timed float value that can be used in a sequence. Implements ISequenceableTimedFloat to allow for value application and timed updates.

Tween

Represents a generic tween operation that interpolates a value over time.

TweenColor

Tween for interpolating between two colors over time.

TweenFloat

Tween for interpolating between two float values over time.

TweenInt

Tween for interpolating between two integer values over time.

TweenRect

Tween for interpolating between two rectangles over time.

TweenVector2

Tween for interpolating between two Vector2 values over time.

Interfaces

ISequenceable

Represents an object that can be updated in a sequence and can create a copy of itself.

ISequenceableTimedFloat

Defines an interface for a sequenceable timed float value, which can apply its value to a given total.

Delegates

Actionable.ActionableFunc

Delegate for the action to be performed.

Repeater.RepeaterFunc

Delegate that is called after each duration for every repeat. Takes the specified duration and returns the duration for the next cycle.
